# Fixture provenance

The `.cpg` files in this directory are **synthetic test inputs**. They were
generated by OpenDepot's own `--create-new` path using the built-in model
schemas, then one file was edited through OpenDepot's zone/channel setters.
They are not copied from a user's radio and their identity fields are fake:

| Fixture | Model | Serial |
|---|---|---|
| `xts2500-800.cpg` | `H46UCF9PW6BN` | `TEST000001` |
| `xts5000-800.cpg` | `H18UCC9PW5AN` | `TEST000002` |
| `mt1500-800.cpg` | `H67UCC9PW5AN` | `TEST000003` |
| `xts2500-edited.cpg` | `H46UCF9PW6BN` | `TEST000001` |

`xts2500-edited.cpg` starts from `xts2500-800.cpg` and applies a zone rename,
a channel rename, and a frequency change.

## Why they exist

They are the behavioral parity target for moving the legacy code into
OpenDepotCore. Each `.cpg` has expected CLI outputs in `../expected/`; the
extraction is correct only when the core reproduces those outputs and the
round-trip byte behavior.

## Caveat

The built-in schemas themselves contain reverse-engineered structural data
derived from shipped ASTRO 25 software for interoperability. The fixtures are
provided as test data, not as original vendor content. If policy requires it,
regenerate equivalents with `../tools/generate_fixtures.ps1` against a local
build of the legacy CLI instead of checking binaries in.

Hashes and sizes are recorded in `MANIFEST.json`.
